title: Navigation / Custom word separator breaks (Cmd+click = help)
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]
(from memory: has been like that from 4.2 and probably earlier too)

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - macOS Tahoe (26.2.0) - Single-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads) - 8.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

I often use `"_"` in variable names and I want them to be treated as separators for easier text editing (it allows my cursor to jump to the middle part of "my_red_timer" and fix it to "my_green_timer" very easily using Option+cursor L/R). The "Interface / Text Editor / Behavior / Navigation / Custom word separator" allows exactly that, but then I can't click on any GDScript stuff that includes "_".

When "Navigation / Custom word separator" is set to "_", clicking on a, for example, "wait_time" in "$my_timer.wait_time = 1" doesn't open Help for "wait_time".

I do not think it should behave like this because this setting is clearly under "Navigation" and not under something like "Parsing" or whatever. I'd expect a setting under "Navigation" to refer to things like cursor commands, drag and drop selection and similar as indeed all other settings under "Navigation" are.

### Steps to reproduce

Set "Settings / Custom word separator" to "_".
Add a timer somewhere in the Scene Tree.
Create a script and add something like `func _ready(): $Timer.wait_time = 1` to it.
Hold Cmd and hover over "_ready". Confirm it gets underlined (if you click on it, Help will indeed open).
Keep Cmd and hover over "wait_time". Nothing gets underlined.

Now turn off "Navigation / Custom word separator" and cmd+lmb on "wait_time" will open Help no problem.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

$"show up countdown".wait_time = 1
